description: .rsry-bead-id exists and contains a non-empty bead id (so the commit-msg hook auto-prefixes per Golden Rule 11)
run: test -s .rsry-bead-id && grep -qE '^[a-z][-a-z0-9]*-[0-9a-f]{6}$' .rsry-bead-id || { echo '.rsry-bead-id missing or malformed; expected one line like cloister-abc123'; exit 1; }
